query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668) AS source_pages, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668) AS facts, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668) AS notes, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668) AS mcqs, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668 AND verification_status NOT IN ('verified','source_attributed','conflicting','unverified','rejected')) AS invalid_verification_statuses, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0664-0668:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668) + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_notes n ON d.entity_type='note' AND d.entity_id=n.id WHERE n.source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668) + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 664 AND 668) AS search_documents LIMIT 1;
